# DueFlow v0.1.4

Turn scattered deadline notices into reviewable tasks, reverse schedules, risk checks, reminders, and calendar exports—while keeping the workspace local.

[Try the 60-second browser sample](https://ustinian5.github.io/DueFlow/#demo) · [Browse the source](https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow) · [See the full changelog](https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.4)

![DueFlow dashboard showing inbox, task, plan, and risk workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow/v0.1.4/docs/images/01-dashboard.png)

## What you can test

- **Local-first intake:** paste text or process Markdown, PDF, OCR-ready image, webhook, and Inbox inputs.
- **Planning beyond extraction:** generate editable milestones, reverse plans, missing-information checks, and deadline-risk flags.
- **Portable output:** export Markdown reports, todo lists, summaries, and standard `.ics` calendar events.
- **No-account browser sample:** build and copy a five-step reverse plan without signup, an API key, or an upload.
- **Desktop companion:** run the Tauri 2 schedule surface and transparent desktop pet with its bundled loopback-only API sidecar.

## Install the macOS developer preview

Homebrew selects the matching Apple Silicon or Intel artifact from the versioned, checksum-pinned cask:

```bash
brew tap ustinian5/dueflow https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow.git
brew install --cask ustinian5/dueflow/dueflow
```

Or download directly:

- [Apple Silicon `.app.zip`](https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow/releases/download/v0.1.4/DueFlow-Desktop_0.1.4_arm64.app.zip) · [SHA256](https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow/releases/download/v0.1.4/DueFlow-Desktop_0.1.4_arm64.app.zip.sha256) · [build manifest](https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow/releases/download/v0.1.4/DueFlow-Desktop_0.1.4_arm64.manifest.json)
- [Intel `.app.zip`](https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow/releases/download/v0.1.4/DueFlow-Desktop_0.1.4_x86_64.app.zip) · [SHA256](https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow/releases/download/v0.1.4/DueFlow-Desktop_0.1.4_x86_64.app.zip.sha256) · [build manifest](https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow/releases/download/v0.1.4/DueFlow-Desktop_0.1.4_x86_64.manifest.json)

The preview is self-contained; Python and Conda are not required at runtime. Each build passed its bundled-backend self-check and strict ad-hoc resource-seal verification. It remains an **unsigned and not notarized developer preview**. Review the [source](https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow), [release guide](https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow/blob/v0.1.4/docs/desktop_release.md), checksums, and manifests before testing it.

## Run from source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow.git
cd DueFlow
conda env create -f environment.yml
conda run -n dueflow python scripts/run_demo.py
```

Expected deterministic result:

```text
DueFlow demo completed
processed=3 tasks=3 plans=17 risks=5
```

Found a problem or have a workflow idea? [Open an issue](https://github.com/Ustinian5/DueFlow/issues/new/choose). If DueFlow fits your deadline workflow, use GitHub's **Star** button to follow future releases.
